description: A claim, 011-aaa, whose only row writes it inside a longer name (011-aaa_x) and holds no Spec path: the visibility reading passes it, no token binds it to the row, so its Owner and its place in a count cannot be graded, and the check says so out loud — UNGRADED, never a silent skip with an OK that says Owners were graded (phase 3 round 2 review R2-1). Exit 0.
